items.t: Lower intake manifold gasket coolant leak
items.job: Replace lower intake manifold gaskets and refill coolant
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $820–$940 total. Add an oil change if coolant mixed with the oil.

items.t: Overheating that damages the head gaskets
items.job: Replace head gaskets (cylinder heads machined or replaced if warped)
items.note: One owner paid about $1,100 for head gasket work after an overheat. Engine damage can make it cost more than the van is worth.

items.t: Automatic transmission slipping or failing
items.job: Rebuild or replace the automatic transaxle
items.note: Owners report averages of about $2,000–$3,500. A used transaxle costs less.

items.t: Hard, harsh or erratic shifting
items.job: Replace pressure control solenoid or service valve body
items.note: Price assumes the transmission itself is still healthy.
